Comprehension:Read the passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.Incorporating right-brain creative processes into traditionally left-brain-dominated fields such as engineering and finance can offer numerous benefits, but it also presents challenges that must be carefully managed. The benefits are innovation and problem-solving, Right-brain creative processes can drive innovation in engineering by encouraging engineers to explore unconventional solutions. For example, creative brainstorming might lead to the development of a more efficient design or a novel application of existing technology. In finance, creativity can lead to innovative financial products or strategies that differentiate a firm from its competitors. Enhanced Design Thinking, right-brain thinking, can improve the aesthetics and user experience of products. Engineers who engage in creative thinking might develop products that are not only functional but also visually appealing and user-friendly. In finance, creative thinking can lead to more engaging and effective communication of complex financial data, making it more accessible to clients. Improved adaptability and creative thinking help professionals in left-brain-dominated fields become more adaptable. For instance, engineers who are comfortable with creative processes may be better equipped to handle unexpected challenges or pivot when a project requires a new approach. Similarly, finance professionals who think creatively may be more adept at developing strategies to navigate market volatility. Successfully incorporating right-brain creative processes into these fields requires a balance between innovation and the rigorous standards that define these professions.According to the passage, which of the following is NOT mentioned as a benefit of incorporating right-brain creative processes into traditionally left-brain-dominated fields?
options: Increased focus on traditional methodologies and standards
Enhanced visual appeal and aesthetics in design
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Increased focus on traditional methodologies and standards) है।
